title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: R&A Enforces Strict Conduct
items.text: The R&A has announced a strict code of conduct for players including Nelly Korda at the Women's British Open to clarify on-course behavior expectations.

items.headline: Jeeno Thitikul Leads Women's British Open
items.text: Jeeno Thitikul opened with a bogey-free 7-under 64 to lead the Women's British Open by two shots at Royal Lytham & St. Annes.

items.headline: Taylor Moore Withdraws from Rocket Classic
items.text: Taylor Moore withdrew hours before his first-round tee time at the Rocket Classic and was replaced by Jimmy Stanger at 1:38 p.m.
